hypothesis.name: PONS–USDG triangle same-size quote-improvement probe

Cohort observations include blocks 97430295 and 97583762, but they do not validate this forward route/size cell or establish an edge.

nextSearch.newInformation: Factory getPool probe results for untested event tokens, including whether additional fee-tier or older companion pools exist. Any discovered route would still need valid, fresh quotes and positive known-net evidence before consideration.
nextSearch.reason: The repeated negative-before-gas results rule out trying to repair those measured routes by weakening entry rules. Expand pool discovery instead: probe previously untested event tokens against WETH/USDG fee tiers and look for older companion pools not visible in the recent event window.
